transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?
What finally made me come in is that my neck, shoulders, and jaw are tight almost all the time. It feels like I’m bracing for bad news, even when I’m just at my desk or trying to watch TV at night.
Do you find yourself constantly worrying about a lot of different everyday things?

Yes. My mind keeps jumping from one thing to another—whether the contractors missed something in the house, whether my lesson plans are slipping, whether the robotics kids are getting behind. Then I worry that I’m letting my wife and family down by not keeping everything under control.
About how long have you been dealing with this kind of constant worry?
About seven months now—since a pipe burst and the remodeling turned the house upside down.
Do you find it difficult to control or stop the worrying once it starts?

Yes. I’ll tell myself to stop and pay attention to the class in front of me, but then something small—an overdue invoice or a student falling behind—starts a whole chain of what-ifs. Once it gets going, I can’t really shut it off.
Have you been having trouble falling or staying asleep since this started?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed a clear change in my sleep.
Have you noticed that you feel more irritable or easily annoyed than usual?
I’m not sure I’ve noticed being more irritable than usual.
Have you been finding yourself getting tired or fatigued more easily than usual?

Yes. By the time the last bell rings, I feel completely wrung out. A decent night’s sleep or a quiet Sunday doesn’t really seem to fix it, and even grading a short stack of quizzes can feel like pushing through mud.
Have you had trouble concentrating or found that your mind goes blank when you're trying to focus?
I can’t say I’ve really noticed that, no.
Do you often feel restless, keyed up, or on edge?

Yes, most of the day I feel pretty wound up, like I’m waiting for something else to go wrong. I catch myself pacing around the classroom or checking my phone between periods to see if the contractor has messaged.
